conventions.reserve: Actual target-pad load minus installed MPC cap is the operative cap reserve gap; actual minus GRF is separate force tracking.
conventions.phase_groups: Execution/safe_stop and probe_transition buckets require a valid certificate. Deliberate probe and recovery have separate buckets. Stand/light-contact excluded.
conventions.statistics: Per-run extrema and durations; correlated control ticks are not independent experimental trials.
